Chapter 1368 - 1: The Myriad Realms Gate’S Transformation

Chapter 1368: Chapter 1: The Myriad Realms Gate’s Transformation

This is indeed true. In the future timeline that they observed initially, there was Lin Yuan using other means to annihilate the Demonic Qi.

Among them, the Taiji Sword, enveloped in endless yin and yang energy, shocked all the Eternal Lords.

"Even the strongest offensive means would find it difficult to obliterate the true form of Black Space in a short time."

Lin Yuan said.

"Obliterate my true form, and in a short time?"

The Master of Black Space blinked.

Although for an Eternal Lord, the fall of a true form is far from true death.

Yet, if even the strongest form can’t ensure survival, it indicates a vast power gap between the two.

...

"What’s your plan next for the Galaxy? Do you want to establish a force of the Eternal Sect?"

The Master of Infinite looked at Lin Yuan and asked.

"Let’s talk about it later."

Lin Yuan answered.

Having just stepped into the Thirteenth Rank, he had too many things to do.

Establish a force? Not urgent for now.

"Hmm."

The Master of Infinite nodded, then continued, "I’ll go back first."

Throughout the long years, he never truly returned to the Origin Source World, at most descending as an avatar, but the avatar’s descent would be perceived by the Demon God and would not last long.

"Alright."

Lin Yuan looked at the other Eternal Lords, "I will leave first as well."

After speaking, Lin Yuan’s figure dissipated and vanished.

...

In a certain time-space.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged.

Floating before him were two crystals.

One was filled with dark Demonic Qi.

One was filled with infinite light.

These were precisely the forms of the Black Demon and the Light of the Lord of Heaven Light.

Lin Yuan carefully observed, looking at the Black Demon Crystal for a while, then the Light Crystal for a while.

At this moment, these two crystals had already transformed into the purest, most primal energy, easily absorbable by Lin Yuan.

There’s no need to crush them with the Taiji millstone, for regardless of which crystal, the purity of their power was not far inferior to the Chaos Void Origin.

This was the legacy of a Time Lord, as Lin Yuan grasped the lord’s status and inherited everything from the Lord of Heaven Light, absorbing the two crystals effortlessly.

"I can feel the immense energy within these two crystals, not at all inferior to experiencing another Chaos Void Origin Infusion."

Lin Yuan’s face brimmed with a smile.

In fact, had the Black Demon form and the Light form not gone through the erosion of endless years, their internal energy drained by nearly half.

The benefits Lin Yuan would gain after refining and absorbing them would certainly exceed the Chaos Void Origin Infusion.

After all, this is the complete inheritance of a Time Lord, and the magnitude of the Chaos Void is merely equivalent to a Time Lord.

"Begin refining and absorbing."

Lin Yuan didn’t hesitate much and immediately began refining the two crystals simultaneously.

Instantly, two completely different forces surged into Lin Yuan’s body, melding into each particle world.

"The path taken by the Lord of Heaven Light is the Path of Light, wherever it reaches, there’s infinite light." Lin Yuan felt a deeper understanding of the path of the Lord of Heaven Light at this moment.

"But having only light is too extreme, reaching a peak is easy, but achieving perfect harmony, difficult, difficult, difficult."

Lin Yuan thought silently in his heart.

"The Lord of Heaven Light realized this, thus possessing the Black Demon form, but in the end, the Black Demon form exists merely to compensate for the deficiency in his Path of Light, hence it was not as powerful as the Light form."

Lin Yuan’s thoughts expanded.

Only having light isn’t truly light.

Only with darkness can there be light.

"My path, since I embarked on cultivation, has been established, grounded in Taiyin and Taiyang, without extremes, and also without hidden dangers." Lin Yuan pondered in his heart.

This is also why he was unwilling to refine the lord’s status of the Lord of Heaven Light.

From deep within, Lin Yuan believed the path he walked was superior to the path of the Lord of Heaven Light.

"I wonder if I strive for the Fourteenth Rank, will I meet the same fate as the Lord of Heaven Light, a death and downfall?"

Lin Yuan pondered secretly.

Even though his path had no flaws or hidden dangers, appearing more perfect than the Lord of Heaven Light’s.

But whether he can ultimately step into the Fourteenth Rank and become a Perfect Time Being, Lin Yuan had no certainty at heart.

His future timeline only reaches the level of a Time Lord at most.

As for beyond that, striving for the Perfect Time Being? It becomes very vague, as the Fourteenth Rank is already beyond all timelines, no matter how strong a Time Being is, it cannot be observed.

"Let’s see when the time comes."

Lin Yuan quickly refined the two crystals while his power rapidly enhanced.

The two crystals were not merely accumulations of pure force, but also contained the path taken by the Lord of Heaven Light.

Lin Yuan refined and absorbed, while at the same time extracting parts he needed from the path of the Lord of Heaven Light.

The path of the Lord of Heaven Light couldn’t be followed directly, but it could be referenced, only in this way can one’s path become ever more complete, approaching perfection.

...

Chaos Void.

A series of blurred phantoms converged.

"Myriad Laws, the Galaxy becomes a great Time Being, you are indeed very fortunate."

Each of the unique spirits looked at the Eye of Myriad Laws, their tones inevitably tinged with envy.

The connection between the Eye of Myriad Laws and the time being ’Galaxy’ had long been speculated by many unique spirits since the latter took initiative to fetch the ’Magic Origin Fruit’ for the Eye of Myriad Laws back then.

The time being ’Galaxy’ was very averse to contact with unique spirits before stepping into the Thirteenth Rank.

He had never met any unique spirit.

Yet he took action to assist the Eye of Myriad Laws in obtaining the ’Magic Origin Fruit.’

If there weren’t some connection in this, the unique spirits would not believe it.

"Indeed, very fortunate."

The Eye of Myriad Laws nodded on the surface, but indeed felt bitter inside.

If only I had known... If only I had not made that request to Lin Yuan, maintaining the favor between the two.
